name: Langflow
description: Langflow is a visual platform for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows. It gives developers a drag-and-drop authoring experience, source-code access for custom Python components, an interactive playground for testing flows, and built-in API and MCP servers that turn workflows into tools for other applications.
short_desc: Build AI agents and workflows visually
author: Langflow
